default.behavior: Show the current enablement, short-term turn count and every explicit long-term memory with source and update time.
default.visibleTruth: Only data returned for the authenticated account is shown.
prohibitedClaims: Do not imply that learning scores or abilities are stored here.
default.freshness: Reload on every page show and after each mutation.
default.correlation: Show the request ID when a server operation fails.

loading.behavior: Show an explicit loading state and disable all mutations until the owner snapshot arrives.
loading.visibleTruth: No stale local memory list is presented as current.
prohibitedClaims: Do not show zero memories before the request completes.
loading.freshness: Bound to the active page request generation.
loading.recovery: A failed request transitions to error with retry.
loading.correlation: The active HTTP request ID identifies failure.

empty.behavior: Explain that 岸岸 has no long-term preference yet and offer one concrete example plus Add memory.
empty.visibleTruth: The authenticated account currently has no long-term memory items.
prohibitedClaims: Do not imply that the structured learning profile is empty.
empty.freshness: Derived from the latest successful list response.
empty.correlation: The list request ID is retained for support.

partial.behavior: Keep the loaded memory controls usable and show which secondary refresh failed.
partial.visibleTruth: Only successfully loaded sections are presented as current.
prohibitedClaims: Do not replace an unknown count with zero.
partial.freshness: Each section retains its own last successful response.
partial.recovery: Retry the failed section without discarding loaded data.
partial.correlation: Show the failed section request ID.

error.behavior: Show a human-readable failure and a retry action; do not mutate local memory state.
error.visibleTruth: The current server state is unavailable.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim a create, edit, delete or clear succeeded without a response.
error.freshness: No failed result is treated as current.
error.recovery: Repeat the idempotent request or reload the list.

expired.behavior: Remove expired short-term turns from the visible count on the next reload.
expired.visibleTruth: Expired conversation turns are no longer usable by 岸岸.
prohibitedClaims: Do not imply expired turns remain active context.
expired.freshness: Short-term expiry is evaluated by the server clock.
expired.recovery: Start a new conversation; no restoration action is offered.
expired.correlation: Use the latest list request ID.

conflict.behavior: Explain that the memory changed elsewhere and reload before allowing another edit.
conflict.visibleTruth: The submitted revision is stale and no overwrite occurred.
prohibitedClaims: Do not silently overwrite a newer memory revision.
conflict.freshness: The local item is stale until reload completes.
conflict.recovery: Reload, reopen the editor and resubmit the exact new state.

recovery.behavior: After an uncertain transport result, reload the server snapshot instead of repeating a different mutation.
recovery.visibleTruth: The prior mutation outcome is unknown until server state is fetched.
prohibitedClaims: Do not announce success from a client timeout.
recovery.freshness: Resolved only by a new authenticated list response.
recovery.recovery: Use the same create idempotency key or reload exact state for PUT and DELETE.
recovery.correlation: Preserve both the mutation and reload request IDs.

processing.behavior: Disable the affected control while one mutation is in flight and keep unrelated facts visible.
processing.visibleTruth: The requested change is pending and not yet confirmed.
prohibitedClaims: Do not optimistically show a durable change as saved.
processing.freshness: The displayed snapshot remains the last confirmed server state.
processing.recovery: On completion reload or apply the confirmed response; on uncertainty enter recovery.
processing.correlation: The mutation request ID identifies the operation.

pages.purpose: Let one authenticated learner understand and control what 岸岸 temporarily and durably remembers.
